The collection holds the following pollutant concentration values:
PLTNT
100 30 10 20 50 100 250 50
The range of pollutant concentration values is from 0 to 500.
The following algorithm in pseudocode is intended to output all elements stored in the
collection :
PLTNT
PLTNT.resetNext()
while PLTNT.hasNext()
X = PLTNT.getNext()
output (PLTNT.getNext())
end loop
(b) (i) Describe why this algorithm does not work as intended. [2]
